pageDescription: To maintain visual hierarchy and consistency across the product, follow these capitalization and punctuation rules:

list.text: Use sentence case wherever possible for body text, instructions and descriptions e.g., only capitalise the first letter in the first word.
letteredItems: More legible, especially when scanning long text as title case slows down comprehension
Speeds up design/development processes as there is less confusion on which style to follow

list.text: Use sentence case for these elements:
children: Alert banners or messages e.g., Your changes have been saved
Buttons e.g., Request new access, Save changes (to capitalise proper noun, e.g. Qlik and services specific nouns)
Dropdown menu items (to capitalise proper noun, e.g. Fuel System or services specific nouns)

list.text: Capitalise all major words (nouns, pronouns, verbs, adjectives, adverbs)

children: Short conjunctions e.g., and, as, but, for, if, nor, or, so, yet.
Short prepositions e.g., as, at, by, for, in, of, off, on, per, to, up, via.
Proper nouns, regardless of their placement in a sentence or title
Country names e.g., United States of America
Product-related names e.g., Platform/System (LMV, Bionx, Hydraulic System), Component (Antenna Digital Communication System)

list.text: Unit abbreviations e.g., hrs, mths, days
Use all-case capitalisation for specific business acronyms or abbreviations e.g., SGT, WY, MTBF, NHPP, TSI, NSN, MPN etc.
To help users scan text more efficiently, unnecessary periods can be omitted.
